origin: Before she became a monster, Arachne was the greatest weaver the world had known. Now she spins not silk, but movement.
story: Every mistake becomes another thread. Every hesitation tightens the web. Fight her with brute strength, and you will be trapped. Fight with rhythm, and you may walk free.
quotes: Never lose rhythm. The web remembers every mistake.
unlockText: Somewhere close, a web is already being spun with your name in the pattern.
victoryText: The thread breaks clean. Arachne's rhythm was yours to keep, in the end.
rule: Never lose your rhythm. The workout is one continuous thread — break it, and the web closes.
hunterAdvice: Never lose rhythm. The web remembers every mistake.
